validation_method.primary: 4-fold stratified by electrode coating on real observations only; synthetic augmentation excluded from every held-out fold
validation_method.paper_match: final model evaluated on all 32 real source rows; an in-sample fidelity check, not a generalization claim

limitations: One research paper, one workpiece (Ti-6Al-4V), and one electrode base material (Aluminium) only.
Predictions outside Current 10-40 A, Voltage 40-55 V, or TON 100-1500 us are outside the observed domain.

MRR and TWR are source-reported mass rates in g/min. The source does not provide the aluminium-electrode density required for a defensible TWR volumetric conversion, so no mm3/min values are fabricated.
Synthetic rows are Shailesh-Sir-derived augmentation only and are down-weighted relative to real observations.

sources.title: Assessing the Effects of Uncoated and Coated Electrode on Response Variables in Electrical Discharge Machining for Ti-6Al-4V Titanium Alloy
